sql: WITH w AS (SELECT w.id, w.contact_name FROM wapi_conversations w JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = w.instance_id LEFT JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = w.lead_id WHERE w.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND i.unit ILIKE '%2%' AND (w.contact_name ILIKE '%ta%n%' OR l.name ILIKE '%ta%n%' OR w.contact_name ILIKE '%thai%' OR l.name ILIKE '%thai%') AND w.last_message_at > now() - interval '2 days' ORDER BY w.last_message_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT w.contact_name, m.timestamp, (CASE WHEN m.from_me THEN 'EU[' || coalesce(m.metadata->>'source', '-') || ']: ' ELSE 'CLIENTE: ' END) || left(coalesce(m.content, m.message_type), 900) AS txt FROM wapi_messages m JOIN w ON m.conversation_id = w.id ORDER BY m.timestamp
